_readme: Unit ladders are DATA. Structure (unit names and bases) comes from
smallest_unit_in_sqm is the ONLY thing that permits cross-ladder arithmetic.
It is a declared exact rational, written as [numerator, denominator] integers.
There are no floats in this file and the loader rejects any that appear.
null anchor = the physical size of this ladder's units has not been measured
from a source we hold. Cross-ladder conversion then REFUSES. It does not guess.
Adding an anchor requires a citation in anchor_source. Do not add one otherwise.

ladders.notes: District unknown. The physical size of a Bihar bigha is not constant across districts, so an area in this ladder must never be converted into any other ladder. Structure per HANDOFF_BUILD.md 3.5.

Same LADDER STRUCTURE as bihar.mithila, different physical unit size. Identical structure is exactly why the ladder id, not the structure, is what makes two areas comparable. Physical size unmeasured -> anchor null.
See bihar.patna. Structurally identical, physically distinct, unmeasured.

ladders.anchor_source: 1 acre = 4840 sq yd; international yard = 0.9144 m exactly (1959 international yard and pound agreement). 1 acre = 4046.8564224 m2 exactly; 1 marla = 1 acre / 160. Ladder structure per HANDOFF_BUILD.md 3.5.
ladders.notes: Anchored because the acre is a defined unit, not a regional one.

ladders.anchor_source: 1 acre = 4046.8564224 m2 exactly (see punjab.standard); 1 guntha = 1 acre / 40. Ladder structure per HANDOFF_BUILD.md 3.5.
ladders.notes: Anchored to the same defined acre, so punjab.standard <-> deccan.standard is exact: 1 guntha = 4 marla.

ladders.anchor_source: Rakba in the Bihar jamabandi RoR is recorded in acres, decimal and hectares; 1 decimal = 435.6 sq ft = 0.01 acre (Evaluation of Quality of Land Records - Bihar, DoLR, p.12 fn.2). 1 acre = 43560 sq ft; international foot = 0.3048 m exactly. See EVIDENCE.md E4.
ladders.notes: THIS is the ladder the Phase 1 audit runs on for Bihar. bigha/katha/dhur is the colloquial and khatian ladder, not what the digitised RoR uses.
ladders.structure_source: Evaluation of Quality of Land Records - Bihar, DoLR, p.12 fn.2: 1 decimal = 0.01 acre. See EVIDENCE.md E4.

ladders.region: metric (hectare column of the rakba field)
ladders.anchor_source: 1 centiare = 1 square metre by definition; 1 are = 100 centiare; 1 hectare = 100 are. Exact.
ladders.notes: Present so the third rakba column can be checked against the other two. A hectare value written to four decimal places is an exact whole number of centiare, which makes that check integer arithmetic rather than an epsilon comparison. See EVIDENCE.md E10.
